name: Muscle-Up
steps: Hang from a fixed bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart in a secure overhand grip.
Pull explosively upward, driving your elbows back and pulling the bar down toward your lower chest or upper abdomen.
Lean your chest swiftly forward over the bar as your elbows rotate above it into the bottom of a straight-bar dip.
Press firmly downward through the bar until your arms lock straight, then lower back slowly through the transition into a hang.
tips: Focus on pulling the bar toward your ribs rather than your chin so you clear enough height for the transition.
Control the negative transition smoothly instead of dropping abruptly off the bar.
